title: Container
note: A COMPONENT schema: it is not part of any category or the base schema. It is added to an individual asset (the asset popup's Add schema button) and stored as its own top-level 'container' block on the manifest. An asset with this block can hold other items up to a weight capacity: the sum of every stored item's weight_kg x count may not pass capacity_kg. Runtime: Assets/Scripts/UI/Containers.cs (the C key opens a container's contents). Containers do not stack in the toolbar (adding the schema sets properties.max_stack_size to 1); stacking_limit is WORLD stacking.

capacity_kg.label: Capacity (kg)
capacity_kg.note: The most weight this container can hold: the sum of weight_kg x count of what is inside.

stacking_limit.label: Stack Limit (placed)
stacking_limit.note: How many identical placed containers can be stacked on each other in one grid square in the world, each keeping its own contents. 1 = they do not stack. In the toolbar a container is always one per slot.

accepts.label: Accepts
accepts.note: What the container accepts: tags (#tag, any member item) and/or exact assets, chosen with the asset picker. Empty = anything. Item categories (for example "food") are also understood by the game if written by hand.

show_fill.label: Show Contents
show_fill.note: Draw what is inside a PLACED container as blocks that rise as it fills (one slab per kind of item: its average colour on the sides and its icon on top). Turn it off for closed boxes, where the inside is not visible.

single_type.label: Single Type
single_type.note: Takes only one kind of item at a time: once it holds something, only more of that same item goes in. It accepts anything again when emptied.
